# Data Merging

## Data Merging

The cleaned datasets are combined using standardized player identifiers and season information. The MLB Stats API and Baseball-Reference datasets are joined using player name keys and year. ABS challenge statistics are then added to the 2026 player records. Player height information is added using MLB player IDs.

## 1. Read Cleaned Data

```{r reading clean data}
mlb_clean <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/processed/mlb_clean.csv"
)

hitting_clean <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/processed/hitting_clean.csv"
)

abs_clean <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/processed/abs_clean.csv"
)

player_height <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/processed/player_height.csv"
)
```

```{r}
mlb_clean <- mlb_clean |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(player_key),
    player_key != "mlb average"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    if (any(team_name == "2TM", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      team_name == "2TM"
    } else {
      TRUE
    }
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Check MLB API duplicates
hitting_clean |>
  dplyr::count(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

# Check Baseball-Reference duplicates
mlb_clean |>
  dplyr::count(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)
```



## 2. Combine MLB API and Baseball-Reference

```{r combine batting data}
mlb_combined <- hitting_clean |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    mlb_clean,
    by = c("player_key", "year")
  )

dim(mlb_combined)
names(mlb_combined)
  
```

## 3. Add ABS Challenge Data

```{r add ABS data}

# Add year to ABS data
abs_clean <- abs_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(year = 2026) |>
  dplyr::distinct(player_key, year, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Join batting data with ABS data
clean_step1 <- mlb_combined |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    abs_clean,
    by = c("player_key", "year")
  )

final_data_all_years = mlb_combined |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    abs_clean,
    by = c("player_key", "year")
  )

final_data_all_years |>
  dplyr::count(year)
```

## 4. Handle Players Appearing on Multiple Teams

For players who appeared on multiple teams during a season, the total-season record (2TM) is retained instead of the individual team records.

```{r handle multiple teams}
clean_step1 = final_data_all_years |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    if (any(team_name == "2TM", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      team_name == "2TM"
    } else {
      TRUE
    }
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

dim(clean_step1)

clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::count(year)
```

## 5. Compare Overlapping Batting Statistics

The batting statistics from the MLB Stats API and Baseball-Reference are compared to check that the merged data is consistent.

```{r compare overlapping batting stats}
clean_step1 = clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(avg.x, avg.y, obp.x, obp.y, slg.x, slg.y, ops.x, ops.y),
      as.numeric
    )
  )

ops_check = clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_difference = abs(avg.x - avg.y),
    obp_difference = abs(obp.x - obp.y),
    slg_difference = abs(slg.x - slg.y),
    ops_difference = abs(ops.x - ops.y)
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_avg_difference = max(avg_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_obp_difference = max(obp_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_slg_difference = max(slg_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ops_difference = max(ops_difference, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ops_check
```

## 6. Select Final Batting and ABS Columns

```{r select final columns}
clean_data = clean_step1 |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name = player_name.x,
    player_key,
    year,
    team = team_name,
    plate_appearances = plate_appearances.x,
    games,
    at_bats,
    hits,
    avg = avg.x,
    obp = obp.x,
    slg = slg.x,
    ops = ops.x,
    home_runs = home_runs.x,
    walks = walks.x,
    strikeouts = strikeouts.x,
    runs_above_avg,
    runs_gained,
    runs_cost,
    challenges,
    challenge_wins,
    challenge_losses,
    win_percentage,
    strikeouts_removed,
    walks_gained
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    abs_data_matched = !is.na(challenges),
    period = ifelse(year < 2026, "Pre-ABS", "ABS-era")
  )

dim(clean_data)
names(clean_data)
head(clean_data)
```

## 7. Prepare Player Height Information

Player height is converted into inches. The conversion extracts the feet and inches from the original height values.

```{r prepare player height}
# Prepare player height
player_height <- people_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id = id,
    height_text = height
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    height_text = as.character(height_text)
  )

# Extract the numbers from each height value
height_text <- trimws(player_height$height_text)

height_numbers <- strsplit(
  gsub("[^0-9]+", " ", height_text),
  " "
)

# Convert feet and inches into total inches
player_height$height_inches <- vapply(
  height_numbers,
  function(x) {
    x <- x[nzchar(x)]

    if (length(x) >= 2) {
      as.numeric(x[1]) * 12 + as.numeric(x[2])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  },
  numeric(1)
)

# Keep one record per player
player_height <- player_height |>
  dplyr::distinct(player_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Check results
head(player_height)
summary(player_height$height_inches)
```

## 8. Add Height to the Main Dataset

```{r join player height}
clean_data = clean_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    player_height,
    by = "player_id"
  )

dim(clean_data)

sum(is.na(clean_data$height_inches))
```

## 9. Create Height Groups

Players are divided into three groups based on their height.

```{r creating different height groups}
height_groups = player_height |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    height_inches
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(height_inches)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    height_group = dplyr::ntile(height_inches, 3)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    height_group = dplyr::case_when(
      height_group == 1 ~ "Shortest Third",
      height_group == 2 ~ "Middle Third",
      height_group == 3 ~ "Tallest Third"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    height_group
  )

clean_data = clean_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    height_groups,
    by = "player_id"
  )

clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(height_group)
```

## 10. Check the Merged Dataset

```{r check merged dataset}
dim(clean_data)

names(clean_data)

# Check for duplicate player-season records
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(player_id, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

# Check the number of records per year
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(year)

# Check player height values
summary(clean_data$height_inches)

# Check ABS data matches
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(year, abs_data_matched)
```

## 11. Save Merged Data

```{r save merged dataset}

readr::write_csv(clean_data,
  "../data/processed/merged_data_before_validation.csv"
)
```
